# Larkspur changelog

## 2.0.0 (2026-08-14)

final.result:
Yes. `go.mod` pins `example.com/larkspur v2.0.1`, and according to `sources/CHANGELOG.md` HTTP/3 support was added in 2.0.0. Before that, 1.8.0 said "HTTP/3 is not supported."

HTTP/3 is experimental and off by default. To turn it on, pass the `--h3` flag or set `Client{H3: true}`.

A side note: the `require` line in `go.mod` uses `example.com/larkspur` with no `/v2` suffix. Go normally expects a v2+ module path to end in `/v2`, so check that the dependency actually resolves to 2.x when you build.
